labels.title: AI credit configuration
labels.immutable: Publish immutable model policies and tenant agreements. Existing operations retain their original rates. Publication does not fund a wallet, activate a provider or schedule tenant cutover.
labels.baseRates: Fixed base credits per 10,000 tokens: uncached input 0.3750; cached input 0.0375; output including reasoning 1.8750. The model multiplier applies to these rates. Enter explicitly approved provider bounds and execution profile.
labels.nativeWarning: Selecting a native File Search overrun policy explicitly permits measured search debt. Leave its model entity ID blank to omit this permission. Ordinary model bounds do not permit overdraft.
labels.lookup: Load an original version by entity ID
labels.replacementNotice: Load the exact original agreement first. Replacement closes only its selection window at the new UTC start; prior prices and admitted work stay unchanged. A new version and prospective start are required.
labels.loadOriginal: Load the original agreement for this tenant before reviewing a replacement.
labels.pending: Publication is unresolved. Retry the exact original command; do not create a new version to recover a lost reply.
labels.sessionExpired: Your session expired. Sign in again to recover the original command.
labels.rejected: The server rejected these terms or could not find the original version. Check IDs, approved bounds and agreement dates.
labels.unavailable: Configuration or retry storage is unavailable. Any unresolved publication retains its original terms.
labels.monthlyCredits: Monthly credits (agreement reference; does not issue grants)
labels.aiNativeSearchModelCreditRateId: Native search overrun model entity ID (optional)
labels.replacesId: Original agreement entity ID being replaced
